title: Psychedelia: The Psychonaut
description:
Psychedelia: The Psychonaut is a pixel art action-adventure where you blaze your way through a psychedelic rebellion. Your motorbike’s been stolen. The world’s been taken over by tyrants and a secret lizard government. Only one thing left to do: trip harder than reality can handle. 

 Every drug you take transforms the visuals, the vibe, and sometimes even what you’re fighting. Drop acid to expose the truth. Eat shrooms to face your demons. Smoke DMT to leave reality behind.

 With every trip, the world distorts, pixel art warps, characters shift, and the line between real and unreal vanishes. Fight back with a lighter in one hand and a burning need for freedom in the other.

 Features: 

• Handcrafted pixel art that morphs when you’re tripping 

• Unique visual effects for LSD, shrooms, and DMT 

• Hilarious, weird characters based on real people and places 

• Boss fights against tyrants, lizard people and your own subconscious 

• A soundtrack that goes hard then gets weird 

• Stoner humor with a soul
description_short: Trip on psychedelics to overthrow tyranny and reclaim your freedom in this trippy action adventure game!
